changeSet.comment: The operation #204 reserved as TRANSFER shipped as "reinvestment" (issue #205); no row uses the value yet
changeSet.sql: ALTER TYPE finances.result_type RENAME VALUE 'TRANSFER' TO 'REINVESTMENT';

rollback.sql: ALTER TYPE finances.result_type RENAME VALUE 'REINVESTMENT' TO 'TRANSFER';

changeSet.author: ${claude}
changeSet.comment: Links the source's REINVESTMENT result to the holding that received its net amount. The source holding, quantity, gross, fees, taxes, cost basis and profit all live on the result row, so none of that is repeated here.
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE finances.reinvestments ( id BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, external_id UUID NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() UNIQUE, result_id BIGINT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES finances.results(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, destination_stock_holding_id BIGINT NULL REFERENCES finances.stock_holdings(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, destination_crypto_holding_id BIGINT NULL REFERENCES finances.crypto_holdings(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, destination_fund_holding_id BIGINT NULL REFERENCES finances.fund_holdings(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, amount NUMERIC NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0), reinvestment_date DATE NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), CONSTRAINT reinvestments_exactly_one_destination CHECK ( (destination_stock_holding_id IS NOT NULL)::INT + (destination_crypto_holding_id IS NOT NULL)::INT + (destination_fund_holding_id IS NOT NULL)::INT = 1 ) );

changeSet.author: ${claude}
